column3: Close to the Hebrew; “a man of worthlessness” (Belial) is rendered “a rebel.”
NKJV renders the uncertain phrase “and tear out our eye” as “and escape us.”
NKJV renders “girded with his robe, his garment” as “dressed in battle armor.”
Close to the Hebrew; “over the forced labor” is rendered “in charge of revenue.”
Close to the Hebrew; כֹהֵן (“priest”) is rendered “chief minister.”
